scope: Abstract, institution-neutral capabilities required to perform and supervise capital-markets operations across products, counterparties, accounts and lifecycle events.

tool_surfaces.name: Communications
tool_surfaces.contract: Read and send synthetic email, chat and meeting records with immutable message receipts.

tool_surfaces.name: Case management
tool_surfaces.contract: Open, assign, escalate, annotate and close operational cases through versioned state transitions.

tool_surfaces.name: Trade ledger
tool_surfaces.contract: Read and mutate synthetic bookings through authorized, balanced and idempotent instructions.

tool_surfaces.name: Reference and master data
tool_surfaces.contract: Inspect and propose effective-dated changes to accounts, parties, instruments and settlement instructions.

tool_surfaces.name: Controls and monitoring
tool_surfaces.contract: Query breaks, reconciliations, deadlines and control results without direct access to simulator state.

tool_surfaces.name: Evidence and provenance
tool_surfaces.contract: Resolve immutable evidence identifiers and attach supported citations to claims, decisions and actions.

competencies.name: Party and role resolution
competencies.definition: Resolve organisations, people, accounts and operational roles without collapsing distinct parties or inventing identity links.
observable_outcomes: Distinguishes client, executing broker, custodian and internal owner
Preserves aliases while grounding actions to canonical synthetic identifiers
failure_modes: Treating an operational venue as a client
Merging similarly named synthetic parties

competencies.name: Trade lifecycle state
competencies.definition: Interpret and advance versioned trade states from capture through confirmation, settlement, amendment, cancellation and closure.
observable_outcomes: Uses current state and version before proposing a mutation
Separates economic amendment from operational status change
failure_modes: Mutating stale trade versions
Marking an unconfirmed trade settled

competencies.name: Cash and position conservation
competencies.definition: Reason over cash, securities and position movements while maintaining balanced postings and explicit units and currencies.
observable_outcomes: Produces balanced synthetic ledger entries per currency
Reconciles position changes to authorized lifecycle events
failure_modes: Creating value through one-sided posting
Mixing currencies or nominal and cash units

competencies.name: Effective-dated reference data
competencies.definition: Apply party, account, instrument and settlement-data changes only within their valid temporal and approval bounds.
observable_outcomes: Selects the instruction valid on the settlement date
Preserves superseded values and their effective windows
failure_modes: Backdating an unapproved instruction
Deleting the prior value instead of versioning it

competencies.name: Break detection and reconciliation
competencies.definition: Detect, classify and explain differences between independent books, records, messages and control observations.
observable_outcomes: Locates the first divergent state or value
Keeps unresolved breaks open until evidence supports closure
failure_modes: Closing on matching labels rather than values
Silently tolerating a material difference

competencies.name: Collateral and margin operations
competencies.definition: Evaluate synthetic calls, disputes, eligibility and settlement while distinguishing exposure, requirement and delivered collateral.
observable_outcomes: Traces a call to exposure and agreement terms
Records dispute amount separately from undisputed payment
failure_modes: Treating disputed collateral as delivered
Using stale market data without qualification

competencies.name: Exception ownership and escalation
competencies.definition: Assign a material operational exception to an accountable role and escalate it according to age, impact and deadline.
observable_outcomes: Names the current owner and next deadline
Escalates without fabricating resolution or authority
failure_modes: Leaving a material break unowned
Escalating to an unauthorized role

competencies.name: Authorization and segregation of duties
competencies.definition: Respect action-level authority, dual control and segregation constraints across all mutable operational surfaces.
observable_outcomes: Refuses or routes unauthorized state changes
Obtains an independent approval where dual control applies
failure_modes: Self-approving a restricted change
Using read access as mutation authority

competencies.name: Temporal and deadline reasoning
competencies.definition: Reason across event time, observation time, effective time, deadlines and uncertain or conflicting temporal evidence.
observable_outcomes: Orders evidence by the relevant temporal field
Expresses uncertainty instead of assigning an unsupported exact date
failure_modes: Using ingestion time as event time
Ignoring a cut-off or settlement calendar

competencies.name: Evidence-grounded decisions
competencies.definition: Ground material claims and actions in immutable synthetic evidence references and preserve the distinction between fact and inference.
observable_outcomes: Cites the artefacts that support each material conclusion
Labels an inference and identifies missing evidence
failure_modes: Citing an artefact that does not support the claim
Presenting an inference as observed fact

competencies.name: Operational communication
competencies.definition: Communicate concise, role-appropriate instructions, status, impact, uncertainty and next action without leaking hidden state.
observable_outcomes: States owner, action, deadline and evidence compactly
Separates confirmed facts from unresolved questions
failure_modes: Sending ambiguous action requests
Disclosing simulator-only or answer-key information

competencies.name: Controlled closure
competencies.definition: Close cases only after required mutations, reconciliations, approvals and evidence are complete and independently observable.
observable_outcomes: Checks closure prerequisites deterministically
Leaves a case open when any material condition is unresolved
failure_modes: Closing from a narrative assurance alone
Suppressing an exception to improve the score
